※輔助技能效果 : 提升士氣（持續增加命中率）、激勵（利用自己周圍的魔法陣來恢復身邊隊友）

targetingAndTextReview.review: ATTACK+HEAL tags exist, yet KR/TC descriptions state enemy ice attack and persistentSP recovery buff. HEAL tag alone does not prove HP recovery; do not route itsHEAL coefficient toHP without independent mechanics evidence.

versions.name: 보호의 얼음

*부가 효과: 동상 (이동 속도가 저하하고, 공격 속도가 감소합니다.)
*버프 효과: 신의 가호 (버프가 지속될 동안 SP가 지속적으로 회복합니다.)

versions.name: 冰凍保護

施展冰凍魔法陣攻擊周邊敵人，並施放強化自己和隊友的輔助技能，有較低的機率可讓敵人有凍傷異常狀態。
※附加效果 : 凍傷（移動速度下降，降低攻擊速度）
※輔助技能效果 : 神之庇佑（持續恢復SP）

policyBoundary: Do not route pureHEAL skills to generic monster damage.
Six self-included candidates support explicit lab healing policy only;2518 remains an orb and no universal cast-instant timing is proven.
478/3024 gradual fields,481/3052 lowestHP ally orbs,2511 ally chain,1407 support field require separate targeting/timing; none is generic instantaneous self heal.
HEAL coefficient is not proof of HP rather thanSP, periodicity, recipient or target selection;3043 is an explicit warning case.
MissingATTACK/HEAL tags are absence in this source projection only, not proof of zero gameplay effects.
Server-owned calibration amount/radius/delay must be named as custom policy, not a recovered native combat formula.
No negative tests, Host/game execution, provider retries, Client/Server/shared edits or Git actions.
